inlineSql: SELECT LC_CODE AS Loct FROM LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LC_CODE
SELECT LC_NAME AS Loct FROM LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LC_CODE

SELECT A.LC_CODE,B.IT_TYPE, SUM(A.ITM_NWT) AS GlNwt,SUM(A.NET_AMT) As NetAmt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME IN ('SALES','WH SALES', 'LABOUR WORK','SALES RETURNE') AND A.ITM_SIGN = '-' AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

SELECT A.LC_CODE, SUM(A.DR_AMT) As NetAmt FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.AC_GR IN ('02','22','03','23') AND A.DR_AMT <> 0 AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

SELECT A.LC_CODE, SUM(A.CR_AMT) As NetAmt FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.AC_GR = '12' AND A.CR_AMT <> 0 AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

SELECT A.LC_CODE,B.IT_TYPE,SUM(A.ITM_NWT) AS GlNwt,SUM(A.NET_AMT) As NetAmt FROM PR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE IN ('OG','OS') AND A.SL_BILL_NO <> '' AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

UNION ALL SELECT C.LC_CODE,D.IT_TYPE,SUM(C.ITM_NWT) AS GlNwt,SUM(C.NET_AMT) As NetAmt FROM SL_PR_DETL AS C LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE And C.IT_CODE = D.IT_CODE WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND C.IT_CODE IN ('OG','OS') AND C.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND C.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

SELECT A.LC_CODE, SUM(A.DR_AMT-A.CR_AMT) As NetAmt FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = '00001' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
SELECT LC_NAME FROM LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? '
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT BOOK_NAME ,CO_BOOK ,BOOK_TYPE,ITM_TYPE,MAIN_BOOK,BOOK_SNAME,BOOK_INOUT,MENU_NAME FROM BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '
Select * From GROUP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND GR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT GR_NAME As GrNameL,GR_CODE as GrCodeL,GR_TYPE as TypeL,TRAD_TYPE As TradTypeL FROM GROUP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY GR_NAME
Select * From PRODUCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT PR_NAME As PrNameL,PR_CODE as PrCodeL FROM PRODUCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY PR_NAME
